headline: Nigerian banks increase deposits at Central Bank despite OMO auction
summary: Banking system liquidity in Nigeria remained high as banks parked N8.31 trillion at the Central Bank of Nigeria's Standing Deposit Facility, even after the regulator mopped up N724 billion via OMO auctions.
why: This indicates high liquidity levels in the Nigerian banking sector, which influences interest rate policy and credit availability.

impacts.name: Nigerian interbank liquidity
impacts.why: High deposits at the central bank reflect excess liquidity in the banking system.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Excess liquidity in the banking system can influence short-term interest rates and inflationary pressures.
